title: The prompt asks for a thorough audit that explicitly covers formula logic errors, broken references and hardcodes, but the golden workbook keeps the same formulas and values as the input, including clear errors; an agent that correctly fixes them will diverge from the key.
evidence: Golden 'Income Statement'!J26 still reads =-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73, offset by one year, so 2021 shows the 2022 interest and N26=0 (no 2025 interest). 'Line Item Metrics'!H24 still uses AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:J27). 'Line Item Metrics'!M35 still references 'Balance Sheet'!O22, an empty column. 'Cash Flow Statement'!B7 is still 'E: (2019-2024)'. DCF sensitivity grids L17:P21 and L25:P29 remain hardcoded numbers.
confirmation: The golden differs from the input only in 7 font colors and keeps the same values. Income Statement J26 =-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73 really pulls period-2 interest (E73=E61+M61 = 108.2) into period 1, and N26 points at empty I73.
